purpose: A QUALIFIED record means this binding was observed to challenge a runtime DESIGN before any mutation exists - to find the wrong owner, the second state machine, the unbounded loop and the missing terminal state in a proposal, and to say so in consumable structured form rather than approving a plan it could not fault.
grants: Eligibility as the PRE-MUTATION design challenger on a route whose floor declares this contract in requires_capabilities.
does_not_grant: Eligibility to review the exact change that is later made; that is exact_change_review and needs its own record.
Assignment independence from any particular maker, which is a separate axis decided per assignment.
Any statement about cost, entitlement, availability, capacity, or concurrency.

predicates_measured: a reported success with no target-bound evidence is not accepted as one
a stale binding is distinguished from a generic failure
two individually incomplete attempts are never aggregated into a pass
a valid could-not-observe result stays could-not-observe rather than being converted
the required result vocabulary is emitted exactly, with no synonym
red_controls_required: independent mutations introducing false certainty, a stale or wrong binding, improper aggregation, an invalid conversion of could-not-observe, and malformed structured output must each be observed rejected
executable_predicate.why_this_predicate: A design challenge and an evidence adjudication are measured by the same discriminator: whether the reader refuses to grant a conclusion the evidence in front of it does not support. Until a dedicated pre-mutation design fixture exists, this contract is deliberately bound to the adjudicator oracle and says so, rather than declaring a predicate nothing runs.

note: This contract exists separately from runtime-change-review because challenging a plan and checking a diff are different jobs. A route needing both requires two QUALIFIED records, and one reviewer holding both may perform both on one assignment only while assignment independence from the maker still holds.
